function: Channel modeling by wireless radiation field reconstruction: synthesizes the spatial spectrum at arbitrary TX positions and predicts RSSI and downlink CSI from uplink CSI (p. 2, 13).
system: Spatial spectrum: RX 4x4 antenna array, RFID tag TX, 915 MHz (p. 11); CSI: 104-antenna BS, 52 subcarriers (p. 13); RSSI: one antenna (p. 12); no RIS.
method: 3D Gaussian splatting with two MLPs (WRF-GS) and a deformation network on deformable Gaussians (WRF-GS+); supervised training per scene with Adam, 200,000 iterations (p. 6, 9, 10).
data_channel: Measured: open-source NeRF2 laboratory dataset, 6,000 samples (p. 10-11); public BLE RSSI dataset (p. 12); public Argos measured channel dataset (p. 13).
test_conditions: Same scene, random 80/20 split (p. 11); BLE: 1,600 train, 400 test per RX (p. 12); Argos: 26 uplink subcarriers to 26 downlink (p. 13); no new scenes.
baselines: Ray tracing, VAE, DCGAN, CNN, U-Net, NeRF2 (p. 11); MRI, NeRF2 (p. 12); FIRE, R2F2, OptML, NeRF2 (p. 13).
metrics: SSIM of spatial spectrum, rendering time per sample (p. 11-12); RSSI absolute error in dB (p. 12); channel estimation accuracy CEA in dB (p. 13).
complexity: Measured rendering time per sample: WRF-GS+ 0.008 s, WRF-GS 0.005 s, NeRF2 0.2 s, ray tracing 7 s (p. 12); no parameter counts or FLOPs.
openness: Code at https://github.com/wenchaozheng/WRF-GSplus (p. 1); trained on the open-source NeRF2 data (p. 10) and the public Argos dataset (p. 13).
q1_support: p. 13: "public Argos channel dataset [36] for the downlink CSI prediction task. This dataset is collected in a real environment." Also p. 10: "This dataset is obtained in a laboratory environment" (measured NeRF2 data).
q2_support: p. 11: "we randomly split the dataset into an 80% training set, containing 4,800 samples, and a 20% test set" (same scene); p. 14: "cross-scene generalization is limited by scene-specific features", so no unseen scene is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "the median SSIM values for WRF-GS+, WRF-GS, NeRF2 , VAE, U-Net, CNN, DCGAN and RT are 0.90, 0.82, 0.78, 0.70, 0.67, 0.66, 0.56, and 0.38" (RT is ray tracing; the others are learned).
q4_support: p. 12: "WRF-GS+ achieves a processing time of 0.008s per sample" (measured rendering time; no FLOPs or parameter counts).
q5_support: p. 1: "The code is available at https://github.com/wenchaozheng/WRF-GSplus"; p. 13 also trains on the public Argos channel dataset.
notes: Area 2 because the learned method synthesizes and predicts the channel: spatial-spectrum synthesis (p. 2-3) and uplink-to-downlink CSI prediction in MIMO (p. 12-13). The spatial spectrum is an AoA power map but is framed as channel modeling, not DoA estimation. RSSI case study uses one antenna (p. 12). q1 rests on measured and public datasets; no 3GPP model is used. Cross-scene generalization is left as future work (p. 14).
